title: A Comparative Transcriptomic Analysis Reveals That HSP90AB1 Is Involved in the Immune and Inflammatory Responses to Porcine Deltacoronavirus Infection.
authors: Zhao, Yujia; Chen, Rui; Xiao, Dai; Zhang, Luwen; Song, Daili; Wen, Yiping; Wu, Rui; Zhao, Qin; Du, Senyan; Wen, Xintian; Cao, Sanjie; Huang, Xiaobo
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过转录组分析HSP90AB1在猪丁型冠状病毒感染中的免疫炎症作用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: PDCoV is an emerging enteropathogenic coronavirus that mainly causes acute diarrhea in piglets, seriously affecting pig breeding industries worldwide. To date, the molecular mechanisms of PDCoV-induced immune and inflammatory responses or host responses in LLC-PK cells in vitro are not well understood. HSP90 plays important roles in various viral infections. In this study, HSP90AB1 knockout cells (HSP90AB1(KO)) were constructed and a comparative transcriptomic analysis between PDCoV-infected HSP90AB1(WT) and HSP90AB1(KO) cells was conducted using RNA sequencing to explore the effect of HSP90AB1 on PDCoV infection. A total of 1295 and 3746 differentially expressed genes (DEGs) were identified in PDCoV-infected HSP90AB1(WT) and HSP90AB1(KO) cells, respectively. Moreover, most of the significantly enriched pathways were related to immune and inflammatory response-associated pathways upon PDCoV infection. The DEGs enriched in NF-kappaB pathways were specifically detected in HSP90AB1(WT) cells, and NF-kappaB inhibitors JSH-23, SC75741 and QNZ treatment reduced PDCoV infection. Further research revealed most cytokines associated with immune and inflammatory responses were upregulated during PDCoV infection. Knockout of HSP90AB1 altered the upregulated levels of some cytokines. Taken together, our findings provide new insights into the host response to PDCoV infection from the transcriptome perspective, which will contribute to illustrating the molecular basis of the interaction between PDCoV and HSP90AB1.
abstract_zh: PDCoV是一种新出现的肠道致病性冠状病毒，主要引起仔猪急性腹泻，严重影响全球养猪业。迄今为止，PDCoV在体外LLC-PK细胞中诱导免疫和炎症反应或宿主反应的分子机制尚不完全清楚。HSP90在多种病毒感染中发挥重要作用。本研究构建了HSP90AB1敲除细胞（HSP90AB1(KO)），并利用RNA测序对PDCoV感染的HSP90AB1(WT)和HSP90AB1(KO)细胞进行了比较转录组分析，以探讨HSP90AB1对PDCoV感染的影响。在PDCoV感染的HSP90AB1(WT)和HSP90AB1(KO)细胞中，分别鉴定出1295和3746个差异表达基因（DEGs）。此外，大多数显著富集的通路与PDCoV感染时免疫和炎症反应相关通路有关。富集于NF-kappaB通路的DEGs仅在HSP90AB1(WT)细胞中特异检测到，且NF-kappaB抑制剂JSH-23、SC75741和QNZ处理可减少PDCoV感染。进一步研究表明，PDCoV感染期间，大多数与免疫和炎症反应相关的细胞因子表达上调。HSP90AB1的敲除改变了部分细胞因子的上调水平。综上所述，我们的发现从转录组角度为宿主对PDCoV感染的反应提供了新见解，这将有助于阐明PDCoV与HSP90AB1相互作用的分子基础。
